revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 1.9% and FY2024 2.9%; a mature global beverage franchise with pricing/mix plus modest volume, so fading from 4.5% to 3.5%, converging toward terminal growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 EBIT margin 28.7% (13,762/47,941); FY2023 24.7%, FY2024 21.2% depressed by one-off items; hold flat at ~28.5%, slightly below FY2025.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. long-run effective rate for KO (not pulled from a tool); Damodaran Beverage (Soft) effective rate 6.8% judged too low for a US-heavy multinational. Reviewer should verify against 10-K tax note.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 0.67 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = CoE 7.9%; unlevered beta cash-corrected 0.575 (Damodaran Beverage (Soft) US) relevered at industry D/E 0.206, 17% tax; pre-tax Kd 5.29% (Damodaran) after-tax ~4.4%; weights 83/17 (Damodaran industry) -> ~7.3%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run nominal GDP growth and below the 4.86% risk-free rate; mature staples business.

net_debt.source: financial_statements KO derived net_debt = LT debt noncurrent 42,119 + current 1,822 + commercial paper 1,495 - cash 10,270; no short-term investments reported; accession 0001628280-26-010047
